summary: Backend + frontend verification for (BUG 1) purge test-data sites detection/scoped deletion and (BUG 2) org_module_access exposure + operator preview module gating. 6/6 pytest cases pass. Frontend module switcher in ?as=operator preview correctly mirrors org's real modules; normal Master Admin navigation retains full access.
critical_code_review_comments: master_admin_test_data_purge.py:_detect_test_sites loads ALL orgs into memory to build id/name maps — fine at current scale but should paginate if org count grows large.
test_data_candidates return type doesn't include site count metadata; frontend has to length-count. Minor UX concern only.
seed_data_creation: Created & then deleted throwaway site 'ZZ QA Purge (test) Site' under master-admin org during test_scoped_purge_site_deletion. No residue.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both bugs verified working. Backend: GET /api/master-admin/test-data/candidates returns sites[] with id/name/organization_id/org_name/reason; dry-run purge returns sites with would_delete=true; scoped purge with site_ids deletes only that site and writes audit. /api/auth/me returns both module_access (master bypass, all true) and org_module_access (real org flags). Frontend: ModuleSwitcher hides Marketing + Comms pills when Marketing is OFF for the org and user is in ?as=operator preview; all pills visible in normal /dashboard nav. Marketing left toggled ON as expected.
rca of the issue: N/A — verifying fixes, both root causes (missing cascade on org delete for sites + master bypass leaking into operator preview UI) addressed via _detect_test_sites orphan/name detection + org_module_access payload consumed by ModuleSwitcher.previewRespectsOrg guard.
